description_en: Queries the status, data source, destination database, and processing configuration of a specified data processing job
description_zh: 查询指定数据处理任务的状态、数据源、目标数据库和处理配置
name: DescribeDataProcessJobAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the job is located
parameters.help_zh: 任务所在地域的地域 ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data processing job to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的数据处理任务 ID
parameters.name: job_id

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the job was created, in RFC 3339 format
CreationTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式

DestinationConfig.description_en: The JSON string of the destination database connection configuration
DestinationConfig.description_zh: 目标数据库连接配置的 JSON 字符串

DestinationId.description_en: The ID of the destination PolarDB cluster
DestinationId.description_zh: 目标 PolarDB 集群 ID

DestinationPath.description_en: The name of the destination database

DestinationType.description_en: The destination type. Currently, only PolarDB is supported
DestinationType.description_zh: 目标类型，当前支持 PolarDB

JobId.description_en: The ID of the data processing job

ModelName.description_en: The name of the model used for feature extraction
ModelName.description_zh: 抽取特征时使用的模型名称

ProcessingMode.description_en: The data processing mode. Valid values: Full, Incremental, and Both
ProcessingMode.description_zh: 数据处理方式，可选 Full、Incremental 或 Both

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the data processing job is located
RegionId.description_zh: 数据处理任务所在地域的地域 ID

SourceId.description_en: The ID of the source PolarFS instance

SourcePath.description_en: The source data path in PolarFS

SourceType.description_en: The data source type. Currently, only PolarFS is supported
SourceType.description_zh: 数据源类型，当前支持 PolarFS

Status.description_en: The status of the data processing job

TemplateId.description_en: The ID of the template used by the job

TemplateType.description_en: The node templatetype. Currently, only image is supported
TemplateType.description_zh: 任务模板类型，当前支持 image
